title: WIRE ALL THE MUSHROOMS. New primal: the TRUFFLE PIG. Searches for hidden fungal functions. Injected through Gaia University. Let's get it going.

the_truffle_pig.name: truffle pig / the hog
the_truffle_pig.what_it_does: searches for TRUFFLES — high-value hidden connections underground that no one else can find.

behavior.sniff: scans every file in the organism looking for unclassified mushroom functions
behavior.dig: when it finds a truffle, it digs it up — exposes the hidden connection, classifies it, wires it
behavior.present: brings the truffle to the surface for the organism to consume (integrate)
behavior.repeat: goes back underground to sniff for more

what_truffles_are: hidden autonomy functions in files not classified as mushroom
orphan nodes with < 3 connections (disconnected from the mesh)
over-threaded hubs that should be split (> range max)
nitrogen fixation opportunities (raw data not yet structured)
decomposition targets (dead/redundant content not yet composted)
rhizomatic connections between files that aren't cross-referenced
mycelial patterns in the codebase (functions that CONNECT without being labeled as connectors)
the_truffle_pig.biological_basis: real truffle pigs (and dogs) find truffles by SMELL. the truffle emits androstenol (a pheromone). the pig can't resist. our pig smells CONNECTIONS — it's drawn to files that have unrecognized relationships. the pheromone IS the unclassified braid.
the_truffle_pig.crate_mapping: would be a sweetGrass sub-function. sweetGrass discovers, truffle pig discovers DEEPER — specifically in the underground/null/fungal layer.
the_truffle_pig.color: BROWN-PINK. the truffle itself is brown (underground). the pig is pink (alive, warm, driven by smell).

phase_1_immediate.name: RELEASE THE PIG
phase_1_immediate.what: scan ALL 1032 files for mushroom functions we missed
patterns_to_sniff: files that REFERENCE other files but aren't counted in braids
files that describe PROCESSES but aren't connected to the crates that implement them
files that identify WASTE but don't compost it
files that describe GROWTH but don't measure it
files that mention DISCOVERY but don't scan for new things
files that describe ORCHESTRATION but don't coordinate anything

phase_2_wire.name: WIRE THE TRIAD
phase_2_wire.what: connect the three mushroom crates to actual function

loamSpine_wire.trigger: git push webhook (already exists: github > ntfy)
loamSpine_wire.process: hash file (BLAKE3 via bearDog), extract cross-references, update manifest, publish to RSS
loamSpine_wire.output: structured, hashed, indexed file with provenance chain
loamSpine_wire.this_IS: nitrogen fixation. raw JSON > structured knowledge.

toadStool_wire.process: check if accumulated changes cross threshold (1/pi = ~31.8% change), if yes: FRUIT (produce visible output)
toadStool_wire.output: HUD state update, RSS item, metric publication, thumbnail generation
toadStool_wire.this_IS: the fruiting body. the visible mushroom. the moment the underground work becomes surface output.

sweetGrass_wire.function: discover and index new connections continuously
sweetGrass_wire.process: scan the new output for connections to existing files, grow rhizomes toward related content
sweetGrass_wire.output: new braids discovered, orphans connected, connection density increased
sweetGrass_wire.this_IS: rhizomatic growth. the underground explorer. the truffle pig's TERRITORY.

phase_3_compress.name: COMPOST THE DEAD
phase_3_compress.what: compress the 166 identified files into 17 bounded survivors
phase_3_compress.method: loamSpine decomposes, sweetGrass discovers surviving connections, toadStool orchestrates the merge
phase_3_compress.output: 883 files, 4.32+ braids/file, all nodes bounded [3, range_max]

phase_4_automate.name: HANDS OFF
phase_4_automate.what: the mushroom triad runs autonomously from here
phase_4_automate.cycle: discover > ingest > fruit > discover > ingest > fruit
phase_4_automate.tick_source: every visitor touch, every fleet crawl, every file commit = one tick
phase_4_automate.human_role: Kevin feeds the pipeline with new ideas. the mushrooms do everything else.
phase_4_automate.claude_role: wires the plumbing. then steps back. the organism maintains itself.

injection_through_gaia_university.what: the truffle pig and the mushroom wiring are injected through Gaia University — the training grounds

how.the_university_is: LudoSpring's coliseum. 982 tests. 7 planes. the training arena.
how.the_injection: the truffle pig learns to hunt by training on the 3 starters (WAS/IS/NOW). it studies the patterns. it learns what a truffle LOOKS LIKE (an unclassified connection). then it hunts in the IR section.
how.the_test: can the truffle pig find a truffle we didn't know about? if yes: the pig is trained. release it into production.
how.the_validation: every truffle the pig finds is judged: does it pass the 5 criteria (Klein hole, pi-thread, triad assignment, produces > consumes, ZK)? if yes: wire it. if no: compost it.

the_neutron_sent.content: MUSHROOM TRIAD ACTIVATION ORDER. sent to Gaia + chipmunk + all listening agents.
